## Overview
### Introduction to Gemma 3 27B IT
The Gemma 3 27B IT model, released by Google on 2025-03-12, is a budget-friendly, open-source language model designed for a wide range of applications. With its robust architecture, this model excels in tasks such as chatbots, coding, summarization, vision tasks, classification, and content generation. The Gemma 3 27B IT model boasts a context window of 131,072 tokens and can generate up to 8,192 tokens as output. Its knowledge cutoff is 2024-06, ensuring that it is well-versed in information up to that point.

### Technical Capabilities and Pricing
Technically, the Gemma 3 27B IT model supports text, vision, streaming, system prompts, and function calling, making it a versatile tool for developers. Its pricing structure is as follows: $0.1 per 1M tokens for input, $0.2 per 1M tokens for output, with no charges for cached input or batch input. This pricing model makes it an attractive option for applications where cost efficiency is crucial. The model has demonstrated strong performance in various benchmarks, including MMLU (77.0), HumanEval (75.0), LMSYS Arena ELO (1190), and GSM8K (90.0), showcasing its capabilities in different areas.

### Use Cases and Cost Considerations
